items.title: Fresh LP Gas designates 39 outlets in Dhaka for BERC-approved prices
items.description: As part of the initiative, the company has initially designated 39 distributor sales points across Dhaka Metropolitan City. Consumers will be able to purchase Fresh LP Gas from these outlets at the MRP set by BERC.

items.title: Govt seeks WB support for business reforms
items.description: Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muktadir yesterday asked the World Bank to support business reforms and export diversification, saying the government aims to cut the time for key business services from 50-55 days or more to 14 days.
